tools.name: drone_check
tools.description: Use when someone asks whether or how they can fly a drone in Thailand, e.g. "can I fly my drone in Phuket", "do I need to register my DJI Mini in Thailand", "drone rules Bangkok", "Drohne Thailand Registrierung", "darf ich in Thailand mit der Drohne fliegen", "Drohne mitnehmen Thailand", "drone Thaïlande enregistrement", "puis-je faire voler mon drone en Thaïlande", "タイ ドローン 登録", "태국 드론 등록", "泰国 无人机 注册", "泰國 無人機 註冊", "регистрация дрона в Таиланде", "רישום רחפן בתאילנד", "registrar dron en Tailandia", "registrare un drone in Thailandia", "drone registreren Thailand", "daftar dron di Thailand", "paano mag-register ng drone sa Thailand", "registrera drönare i Thailand", "registrere drone i Thailand", "droonin rekisteröinti Thaimaa". Returns what a hobby or tourist pilot needs (CAAT and NBTC registration, insurance, flight rules, restricted areas for the place) with public sources, and a link to the DroneClear service information page that fits (DroneClear can handle the registration for you). It gives no prices. It covers hobby, leisure and tourism flights only: if the flight is paid or commercial (filming for a client), set purpose=commercial; the answer then gives only a scope notice and a contact link. If the user has not said whether the flight is for hobby or paid work, ask them first (purpose=unsure returns that question). Thailand only: places in other countries get an out-of-scope answer.

weight_g.description: Take-off weight in grams, if known.

drone_model.description: Drone model, e.g. "DJI Mini 4 Pro". Give this or weight_g.

has_camera.description: Does the drone carry a camera?

location.description: City or area in Thailand, e.g. "Bangkok", "Phuket".

purpose.description: Why they fly. Use commercial for any paid work, filming for a client or business use; leisure_tourism for holiday and hobby flights; unsure only if the user has not said (the tool then asks them).

has_caat_registration.description: True if the pilot already holds a CAAT registration and only needs NBTC.

language.description: Answer language: en, de, fr, ja, ko, zh, zh-hant, ru, he, es, it, nl, ms, tl, sv, no, fi (match the user; for any other language use en and translate the answer).

tools.name: how_droneclear_helps
tools.description: Use when someone asks whether DroneClear (or anyone) can handle drone registration or liability insurance for them in Thailand, e.g. "can someone register my drone in Thailand for me", "kann DroneClear meine Drohne in Thailand registrieren", "qui peut enregistrer mon drone en Thaïlande". Explains in a few lines how DroneClear Thailand helps hobby and tourist pilots (CAAT and NBTC registration handling, NBTC-only handling, liability insurance) with a link to the information page for each. It gives no prices. Not for paid or commercial flights.

language.description: Answer language: en, de, fr, ja, ko, zh, zh-hant, ru, he, es, it, nl, ms, tl, sv, no, fi (match the user; for any other language use en and translate the answer).
